welcome_offer.description: Earn 75,000 Aeroplan bonus points after spending $4,000 on purchases in the first 3 months, plus 40,000 bonus points after spending $20,000 on purchases in the first 12 months (up to 115,000 total).
notes: Official Chase Aeroplan page checked 2026-09-29 labels this "Our best offer ever" (up to 115K, previous 60K struck through); no end date shown.
Card refreshed: $195 annual fee, 3x travel, 2x gas, $100 annual Air Canada credits, automatic Aeroplan 25K status.

earning_rates.notes: 3x points on purchases made directly with Air Canada (plus 2x from Air Canada when traveling as Aeroplan 25K).
3x through 2026-12-31, then 2x points at grocery stores.
3x through 2026-12-31, then 2x points on dining including takeout and eligible delivery.

other_benefits.name: Aeroplan 25K Status
other_benefits.description: Automatic Aeroplan 25K Status for new cardmembers with no spend requirement.

other_benefits.name: Free first checked bags
other_benefits.description: Cardmember and up to 8 others on the same reservation get a free first checked bag on Air Canada-operated flights.

other_benefits.name: Air Canada statement credits
other_benefits.description: Up to $100 annually: up to $50 in Air Canada statement credits delivered twice a year on eligible transactions.

sources.notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-09-29: 75k after $4k/3mo + 40k after $20k/12mo, $195 fee, earning rates and benefits.

recurring_credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Application Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $120 statement credit reimbursing Global Entry / TSA PreCheck application fee. Renews every 4 years.

recurring_credits.name: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $10 off one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter (DashMart, 7-Eleven, CVS, Safeway, etc.). Requires active DashPass enrollment. Per Chase cobrand-doordash terms.
